data.name: Gunjitha
data.gender_notes: Gunjitha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gunji, meaning 'sound,' represents the triumphant and victorious vibrations of the universe. Tha, signifies Goddess Tripura Sundari, the embodiment of female power and creativity. Thus, Gunjitha is the one who brings the sound of victory in the presence of the divine. The name Gunjitha carries the meaning “Sound of Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gunjitha usually hope their child will grow to embody sound of victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embraces the divine feminine and triumphs through spiritual strength.
data.etymology: Gunjitha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sound of Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gunjitha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
